entity.description:
Later, Doctor Manhattan undid his actions and allowed Alan Scott to become once again the Green Lantern and form the Justice Society. Atom Smasher was brought back to life and was part of the Justice Society, along with the other heroes, helped Superman defeat the metahumans who were ravaging Washington, D.C..

He was among the heroes who lost his powers when Amanda Waller seized power but regained them after taking them back from the person they drifted to thanks to a device made by the Atoms (Ray Palmer & Ryan Choi).
